rationale: The stock gapped down nearly 15% at the open and is now printing fresh session lows with accelerating downside momentum across the last five 1-minute candles (each close lower, volume surging on the final bar to 34,806). While the extreme relative volume (12x) and gap suggest a potential exhaustion/reversal setup, price is sitting exactly at the intraday low with no evidence of a base or stabilization — entering long here risks catching a falling knife, and entering short after a 15% gap-down with no bounce structure risks a violent snap-back. The spread of ~39 bps on a volatile, thinly-traded development-stage gold name adds meaningful friction; the risk/reward is insufficiently defined to justify a position at this moment.
